headline: Nvidia governance turmoil amid congressional scrutiny and export restrictions
body: Nvidia is facing simultaneous pressure from political scrutiny over congressional stock holdings, U.S. Commerce Department export bans affecting its partners, and internal governance questions about board independence following CEO Jensen Huang's reinstatement. For healthcare AI vendors relying on Nvidia infrastructure for clinical AI models and EHR integrations, supply chain instability and regulatory uncertainty create execution risk. Healthcare organizations building GPU-dependent AI pipelines for diagnostics or operational analytics should monitor Nvidia's regulatory exposure and evaluate contingency vendor relationships to avoid disruption to AI deployment timelines.
